mapper.sql: bbs02_notice_id AS notice_id , bbs02_company_id AS company_id , TO_CHAR(bbs02_from_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS from_date , TO_CHAR(bbs02_to_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS to_date , bbs02_open_yn AS open_yn , bbs02_notice_no AS notice_no , bbs02_notice_type AS notice_type , bbs02_notice_type_nm AS notice_type_name , bbs02_notice_detail_cd AS notice_detail_code , bbs02_notice_detail_nm AS notice_detail_name , CASE WHEN bbs02_notice_detail_nm IS NULL THEN bbs02_notice_type_nm ELSE CONCAT(bbs02_notice_type_nm, '-', bbs02_notice_detail_nm) END AS notice_detail_full_name , bbs02_title AS title , bbs02_note AS note , bbs02_notice AS notice , bbs02_user_id AS user_id , bbs02_user_nm AS user_name , (COALESCE(bbs02_public_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS public_yn , (COALESCE(bbs02_public_company_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS public_company_yn
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM bbs WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(bbs02_notice_type_nm, bbs02_notice_detail_nm, bbs02_title, bbs02_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{c.searchText}) AND bbs02_open_yn LIKE #{c.openYn}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs02_notice (bbs02_notice_id, bbs02_company_id, bbs02_user_id, bbs02_user_nm, bbs02_create_user_id, bbs02_create_date, bbs02_title, bbs02_notice, bbs02_from_date, bbs02_to_date, bbs02_open_yn, bbs02_note, bbs02_notice_type, bbs02_notice_detail_cd, bbs02_public_yn, bbs02_public_company_yn, bbs02_notice_no, bbs02_comment_yn) VALUES (#{r.noticeId}, #{r.companyId}, #{r.userId}, #{r.userName}, #{r.userId}, f_sysdate(), #{r.title}, #{r.notice}, #{r.fromDate}::date, #{r.toDate}::date, #{r.openYn}, #{r.note}, #{r.noticeType}, #{r.noticeDetailCode}, #{r.publicYn}::text, #{r.publicCompanyYn}::text, #{r.noticeNo}, 'false')
mapper.update: UPDATE bbs02_notice SET bbs02_title = #{r.title}, bbs02_notice = #{r.notice}, bbs02_from_date = #{r.fromDate}::date, bbs02_to_date = #{r.toDate}::date, bbs02_open_yn = #{r.openYn}, bbs02_note = #{r.note}, bbs02_notice_type = #{r.noticeType}, bbs02_notice_detail_cd = #{r.noticeDetailCode}, bbs02_public_yn = #{r.publicYn}::text, bbs02_public_company_yn = #{r.publicCompanyYn}::text, bbs02_notice_no = #{r.noticeNo} WHERE bbs02_notice_id = #{r.noticeId} AND bbs02_company_id = #{r.companyId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.bbs04_target_company_id AS target_company_id , a.bbs04_notice_id AS notice_id , a.bbs04_company_id AS company_id , b.sys01_company_nm AS company_name FROM bbs04_target_company a INNER JOIN sys01_company b ON b.sys01_company_id = a.bbs04_company_id WHERE bbs04_notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs04_target_company (bbs04_target_company_id, bbs04_notice_id, bbs04_company_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{noticeId}, #{companyId})
mapper.select: SELECT bbs09_notice_history_id AS notice_history_id , TO_CHAR(bbs09_reg_date, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_date_str , bbs09_open_yn AS open_yn , f_emp_kor_nm(bbs09_person_id) AS person_name , (bbs09_notice IS NOT NULL) AS content_yn , bbs09_notice AS notice FROM bbs09_notice_history WHERE bbs09_notice_id = #{noticeId} ORDER BY bbs09_reg_date DESC, bbs09_notice_history_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs09_notice_history SELECT f_create_seq(), #{noticeId}, #{personId}, f_sysdate(), #{openYn}, #{notice}, null
mapper.select: SELECT emp01_person_id AS person_id , emp01_kor_nm AS kor_name , emp01_mobile_telno AS mobile_tel_no FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id IN #{id}
